quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: Nokia accelerates AI-RAN adoption as global operators (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI-RAN on NVIDIA platforms: A1 Group, Chunghwa Telecom, du, e&, Mobily, stc, TPG Telecom and Zain Saudi are among operators advancing AI-RAN proofs of concept and live trials with Nokia using NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computer (trials, not commercial deployments); earlier evaluations with T-Mobile, SoftBank and Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison and trials with NTT DOCOMO continue. Nokia claims its AI-RAN platform has already delivered more than 20% improvements in spectral efficiency, with a software roadmap for further gains in 2027 and 2028, and describes it as the industry's first commercial AI-native RAN platform (company claim).
quarterly_data.figure: eight newly named operators in AI-RAN proofs of concept / live trials; more than 20% spectral-efficiency improvement (company claim)
